system_consequence_review.scope: Interaction of the nine proposed reliability repairs with cost routing, caching, concurrency, publication and recovery.

findings.downstream_effect: Moving ownership operations into generic interactive capacity can starve authentication, user requests and health checks. Nested company leases can create synchronized renewal bursts.
findings.required_constraint: Reserve bounded metadata capacity within the existing database ceiling and preserve interactive headroom. Apply the metadata class only around short claim/renew/release operations; never let the yielded research body inherit elevated admission.
findings.evidence_limit: The successful one-holder control is a mechanism check, not a mixed-workload capacity qualification.

findings.downstream_effect: Continuing after a transient renewal error can let a suspended old worker run past actual lease expiry and race its replacement. A pre-write owner check has a race with takeover.
findings.required_constraint: Use the last confirmed valid lease deadline conservatively; stop on confirmed loss or expiry. Guard checkpoint mutations and the authoritative publication commit with current ownership. Retain existing Blob generation ordering and ETag conditions; SQL ownership checks alone do not fence Blob writes.

findings.downstream_effect: Per-company writes increase SQL load; independent latest pointers can expose mixed component versions. Faster companies can dominate visible coverage while difficult investigations remain pending.
findings.required_constraint: Persist completed work durably with stable task identity and controlled write concurrency. Publish a coherent artifact referencing its exact component versions and original observation dates. Preserve earlier useful results when refresh fails and give deferred work fair continuation.

findings.downstream_effect: Replacing NaN/Infinity with null can hide analytical data errors. Different normalization in identity hashing and storage can cause needless cache misses or inconsistent reuse.
findings.required_constraint: Use one canonical representation for persistence and relevant cache identity, retain raw inputs/provenance and distinguish data-quality errors from ordinary missing values. Never turn missing values into numeric zero.

findings.downstream_effect: An independent cleanup allowance can accidentally restart the job clock or permit an expired owner to publish. Secondary logging failures can still replace the originating exception.
findings.required_constraint: Keep finalization inside the original total deadline; separate audit recording from permission to mutate research or publish. Preserve original failure and attach secondary recording outcomes separately.

findings.downstream_effect: Reserving more completion time reduces acquisition time. Restoring Pro reviews increases cost and can activate inherited memory writing; repeated review may spend money without useful changes.
findings.required_constraint: Keep full evidence and analytical capability. Use one explicit review owner per artifact, checkpoint completed stages and reuse compatible accepted review results. Judge complete output quality, acquisition coverage, latency and cost together.

findings.area: Shared balance and ambiguous provider attempts
findings.downstream_effect: Reusing shared balance state without atomic reservations can overspend available credit. Long waits can consume the writing budget. Blind retries after an ambiguous provider response can pay twice.
findings.required_constraint: Retain atomic reservations and explicit pending/unknown usage. Bound refresh waits within the same request/run clock; do not blindly replay ambiguous paid calls or erase unknown reservations. Exactly-once paid inference is not established.

findings.downstream_effect: Disabling writes everywhere would stop useful knowledge growth. Deferring learning work can create an indefinitely growing backlog or repeated partial stages.
findings.required_constraint: Composition stays read-only while the owning research/learning stage retains explicit write authority. Learning resumes durable per-stage state with fair admission and visible backlog age; review and knowledge mutation retain independent idempotent identities.

findings.downstream_effect: execute_with_fallback retains rollback for the entire policy identity. One infrastructure failure can disable cheaper routing and company reuse on later executions until policy changes or is deliberately rearmed. The captured production state already has rollback=true for the October27.3 policy.
findings.required_constraint: Distinguish infrastructure deferral/recovery from evidence that model/policy quality needs rollback. Preserve safe baseline selection after failure, make active mode inspectable and require deliberate rearming after recovery qualification. Resume failed stages from retained sources; do not restart completed acquisition.

findings.downstream_effect: Fewer failed requests and restored reviews can increase actual spending compared with a failing pipeline. More workers can amplify provider, browser and database pressure. Two scheduled runs can accumulate more work per run.
findings.required_constraint: Retain explicit aggregate concurrency bounds and the original execution clock. Compare complete-workload costs, useful completed coverage and output quality; include failed, retried and unknown usage. Do not claim90percent savings from cadence or per-call arithmetic.

Provider response is ambiguous or balance refresh is busy without losing reservations or resetting deadlines.
Writing/review fails after acquisition, then resumes without reacquiring sources or repeating knowledge writes.
Learning repeatedly approaches its execution bound without starving old pending cases.

adaptive_budget_requirement.owner_instruction: The budget should be able to scale from $10 per run all the way to $1000+ per run. So the research quality/depth all should be variable.
adaptive_budget_requirement.scope: Shared production research engine. Configuration range does not itself start a run, approve spending, change production schedules or supersede the separate offline-study provider/daily approval policy.
adaptive_budget_requirement.budget_meaning: Maximum incremental research spend for one logical objective, including child tasks, retries and fallback. A larger ceiling permits deeper work; it is not a requirement to consume the allowance.

controls.max_cost_usd: Any supported positive finite USD ceiling, including10,1000 and above; no hardcoded quality tiers.
controls.max_duration_seconds: Independent run limit; preserve the existing two-hour production setting unless explicitly configured otherwise.
controls.concurrency: Independent capacity limits for model calls, acquisition, browsers and database work; money alone does not increase them.
controls.research_objective: The requested question and scope, carried to the shared LLM planner.

adaptive_behavior: The LLM planner allocates remaining money and time among breadth, depth, source acquisition, counterevidence, numerical work, eligible task models, synthesis and review. It can conclude early when further work has little expected value.

Use declared supported model/tool capabilities, versioned price bounds and observed latency. Reserve the cost of each paid action before admission; completion and publication need funded time/effort rather than a fixed percentage imposed on every task.
Each child sees an allocation from the parent allowance. Concurrent workers cannot each treat the full run ceiling as their own budget.
Budget and depth can change the research performed and model choice; provenance, truthful dates, execution outcome, permissions and accounting remain required at every budget.

accounting.available: approved ceiling minus settled spending minus outstanding maximum reservations, including ambiguous attempts
accounting.atomicity: Coordinate account affordability and run allowance reservations so failure in one cannot leak the other reservation.
accounting.retry: A retry or model fallback keeps the original logical run identity, spending, reservations and deadline.
accounting.paid_tools: Include incremental paid inference and acquisition; rented compute requires allocation-wide reservation. Fixed shared hosting is reported separately rather than silently represented as per-request spend. Unpriced paid actions need a bounded quote before admission.
accounting.changes: Freeze the approved profile for a run; an explicit owner budget amendment can increase its ceiling while retaining all earlier spending and work.

reuse_and_depth: Preserve complete captured inputs and completed research stages independently of the allowance used to obtain them. Increasing the requested budget/depth should extend useful work rather than discard it.

A cheaper completed answer is retained input for a deeper investigation, not automatic proof that the deeper objective is complete. The shared LLM assesses achieved scope and worthwhile remaining questions.

Cache compatibility follows evidence, requested analytical scope, effective model/prompt/schema and permissions. A worker-count or dollar-ceiling change alone must not invalidate unchanged completed input artifacts.
adaptive_budget_requirement.fallback: Keep infrastructure continuation, per-run model fallback and deliberate release rollback separate. A transient database error must not silently impose permanent baseline economics. Fallback cannot reset or exceed the approved run ceiling.
source_changes_required: The current ResearchBudget expresses time phases, not a dollar allowance.
Current provider reservations protect account credit, not a logical run spending cap.
The current planner sees tool/time counts but has no shared run-dollar ledger.
Current cache identity includes the complete inference policy and several execution-budget parameters; budget changes can invalidate otherwise useful work.
Current fixed per-company admission and phase allocations cannot express continuous budget-dependent research depth.

account_wide_target.meaning: 90percent reduction is a measured economical operating profile, while higher explicitly selected budgets buy additional research depth.
account_wide_target.implication: News-only optimization cannot meet the account-wide target while other producers remain unchanged.

adaptive_budget_requirement.acceptance: Compare the same objectives and retained inputs across materially different budgets, personally evaluate complete outputs and attained depth, verify hard concurrent spend bounds and resume behavior, and qualify production recovery/publication. No new model calls were started to write this design.

allocation_design.current_runtime_gap: The shared ledger enforces a ceiling but admits requests in arrival order. Planner context is advisory; no funded completion escrow, parent-assigned investigation grants or coordinated allocation among subjects exists yet.
allocation_design.objective: Maximize useful research within the approved objective, dollars and deadline. Greater allowance permits deeper or broader work; it neither requires expenditure nor silently expands the requested scope.

funding_order.stage: Inspect retained work and current changes
funding_order.behavior: Build one shared inventory of retained findings, full sources, dates, material changes and unresolved questions. Charge planning and materiality assessment to the run. Use this to avoid purchasing the same company/event/source investigation independently for several consumers.

Fund the writing and required review of every admitted investigation, plus required aggregate composition/finalization. Quote against actual model, bounded context/output and declared completion stages. Enlarge this obligation before admitting a scope/context increase. Reserve dollars and time independently; no fixed percentage guarantees completion.

The shared LLM planner ranks worthwhile questions using task importance, material changes, uncertain claims, counterevidence, existing coverage, shared dependencies and expected incremental usefulness. It proposes bounded work and the completion obligations it creates. Budget amounts are constrained by ledger arithmetic; research priorities are not hardcoded.

Grant each investigation enough for a useful next stage and its finish obligation. All grants share the parent allowance and usable provider credit. Available worker count is a capacity ceiling; unfunded investigations wait. A grant expiring or needing more funds triggers checkpoint/reallocation, never permission to consume the remaining parent pool.

At material findings, contradictions, completed stages or an exhausted grant, reassess which next work most improves the objective. Return unused grant funds and expand promising investigations. Preserve room for important uncertain questions rather than selecting only cheap easy requests. Reuse the existing planner and reallocate at useful milestones; coordination costs are included.

Finish funded work using its protected allowance, publish completed results and retain unfinished investigations. Retry or baseline fallback retains the original clock, spending and evidence. A failed cheap stage can escalate within remaining funds; it does not obtain a second budget.

ledger_contract.invariant: cap = settled charges + in-flight/unknown maximum reservations + protected future completion + unspent investigation grants + unallocated funds
ledger_contract.no_double_counting: Starting a funded request atomically moves funds from its grant/completion hold into an in-flight reservation; it does not reserve those dollars a second time. Settlement debits actual/bounded cost and returns unused headroom.
ledger_contract.admission: Commit run allowance, allocation authority and applicable provider-account affordability together. Remote planning/price queries occur outside the SQL transaction.
ledger_contract.completion_growth: No new investigation, source-context expansion or more expensive model may create an unfunded finish obligation. If the requested scope cannot fit, retain honest partial completion rather than silently declaring the objective satisfied.
ledger_contract.handoff: Reclaim unspent grants only with fenced allocation authority. In-flight and unknown paid attempts remain obligations after worker loss; reconciliation, not lease expiry alone, releases them.
ledger_contract.amendments: An explicit owner amendment retains spending, outstanding requests and all protected/granted funds. An ordinary retry or configuration change cannot increase the retained allowance.

model_use.economy: Eligible bounded extraction, evidence organization, duplicate/materiality assessment and intermediate summaries; originals and dates remain available.
model_use.full: Material interpretation, competing explanations, numerical assumptions requiring substantive reasoning, consequential synthesis and required review. Escalate economy work when substantive ambiguity warrants the cost.
model_use.measurement: Route suitability and completion quotes must be calibrated on complete retained-source outputs and actual attempt costs; no claim that cheap routing or more spending guarantees quality.

scaling_examples.ten_dollars: Favor retained knowledge and focused research on the most consequential unresolved changes. Protect full-model interpretation/review for admitted work; broader subjects can retain dated prior findings or honest pending status.
scaling_examples.one_thousand_plus: Permit more eligible investigations, fuller primary-source acquisition, alternative explanations, numerical scenarios and additional useful checking, within the same configured time and physical capacity.
scaling_examples.not_tiers: These illustrate expected behavior, not coded dollar thresholds, source counts or compulsory spending.

qualification: A high-cost early subject cannot exhaust other funded work or completion.
Concurrent children, retries and fallback never duplicate money or paid acquisition.
A larger allowance/depth request preserves captured evidence and reassesses whether prior analysis is sufficient.
Quotes, partial failures and ownership handoffs retain consistent obligations and truthful completion states.
Personally compare complete outputs and achieved breadth/depth for the same retained objectives under materially different allowances, respecting the separate offline-study provider/spending rules.

implementation: All execution-state persistence paths normalize nested pandas/NumPy missing and nonfinite values through shared to_jsonable; JSON encoding rejects remaining nonfinite numbers. Artifact result hashes use the normalized representation.
Company worker failures emit a recorded failure and allow independent completed companies to reach aggregate materialization; the producer records degraded research and continuation.
A cancelled rollout audit cannot replace the original exception. Previously retained started state still selects baseline after replica death.

Short ownership claim/renew/release operations use existing reserved interactive database capacity. Transient renewal errors retry within confirmed lease validity; confirmed lease loss still cancels work. Renewal errors retain their type and validity remaining.

The logical run ledger supports continuous positive USD caps, integer microdollar accounting, atomic account/run reservation, bounded waits for active requests to return headroom, idempotent settlement and retained unknown charges.
Replica identity retains its original configured allowance. Later configuration does not reset a retained ledger. Explicit audited amendments change the cap while retaining spending and reservations.
Shared planning receives live remaining dollars, reserved/settled spending and model/tool prices alongside its existing clock and research state.
Paid Serper, SerpApi and Tavily transport requests share the ledger. Capped runs require configured maximum search charges. Disconnected or ambiguous requests keep their reservation.

configuration.RESEARCH_RUN_BUDGET_USD: Initial positive finite USD allowance for a new logical run; blank preserves existing uncapped configuration. Examples10,1000,10000.75 are contract fixtures, not approved spending.
configuration.RESEARCH_TOOL_MAX_COST_USD_JSON: Deployment-owned maximum prices per paid search request; missing quotes block that paid acquisition in capped runs. Explicit zero requires an actually covered/free plan.
configuration.LLM_PRICE_SNAPSHOT_PATH: Versioned model prices; capped transport reserves a known context/output bound and refunds unused headroom against metered usage.
configuration.amend_research_budget: Administrative service function, not an agent tool; requires an authorization reference, approving identity and idempotent amendment identity.
configuration.independence: Dollar changes do not change worker count, producer deadline or production schedules.

verification.scope: Operational/accounting contracts only. Actual isolated PostgreSQL, real admission and ownership code, simulated provider/search responses. No paid inference, research GPU or production execution started.
verification.database_cleanup: Every diagnostic cluster stopped and postmaster.pid absence checked before archiving.
verification.additional_baseline_failure: A broader research-session test expects resumable=False although unchanged source returns durable=True. Reproduced the same failure on the prior release branch. Not changed or counted as passing.

remaining_implementation_and_acceptance: Fund and qualify completion phases while varying breadth/depth and task-model choices; planner financial context alone does not establish adaptive research quality.
Decouple completed evidence identity from execution capacity/budget parameters; assess adequacy of retained shallow answers for deeper objectives and reuse captured work across baseline fallback.

Complete deadline-driven publication of the completed subset, durable incremental aggregate recovery and storage-native publication fencing. Per-company isolation alone does not establish whole-run publication.

Reconcile interrupted or late accounting receipts into run and account ledgers, and qualify bounded retention of received paid results after child cancellation. Unknown obligations currently remain conservatively reserved.

Include bounded incremental rented-compute/tool categories beyond the integrated inference/search transports before claiming complete research-spend coverage; fixed shared hosting remains separately reported.
Qualify ownership renewal with mixed interactive/background production-shaped load and actual producer persistence/retry; short-TTL local checks are not complete scheduled-run acceptance.
Resolve primary-candidate synthesis failures using retained complete evidence and personally evaluate full outputs, including dated event wording.
Bound learning case admission/continuation and establish the afternoon platform termination cause.
Review all affected consumers, accept complete local behavior, build only accepted Git source, qualify the exact image in DEV, then use the existing conditional production authorization.
Measure whole-account recurring cost and useful research coverage against the original baseline. No90percent reduction claim is supported yet.
